theme: Myth-busting: common misconceptions about mutual funds, addressed simply
headline: Mutual Funds Need Large Money to Start
body: False. Systematic Investment Plans allow you to begin with amounts as small as your budget permits, making investing accessible to everyone.
caption: Starting an investment journey doesn't require a fortune. Even modest, regular contributions can help your money grow over time. Begin when you can, not when you have plenty. #MutualFundMyths #InvestingBasics #SmallStepsToWealth #DebunkingMyths #MoneyGrowth
